---
name: Installation or launch problem
about: Report a problem with the ARC-D ROCKNIX integration
---

## Setup

- Handheld model:
- Official ROCKNIX version:
- Integration package version:
- Did normal stock Saturn games work before installation?
- Were external controllers connected?

## What happened

Describe the install/launch action and what appeared on screen. Say whether the game returned to the menu, froze, or rebooted the whole handheld.

## Logs

Attach `Pirry-Install.log` from `ports` and the latest relevant part of `last-launch.log` if a game failed. Do not attach achievements passwords, token files, ROMs, BIOS or personal save folders.
